entry.title: New: Bill 73 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AMENDS ORDINANCE NO. 23-50, AS AMENDED, THE OPERATING BUDGET FOR THE COUNTY OF HAWAIʻI FOR THE FISCAL YEAR ENDING JUNE 30, 2024

Appropriates revenues in the 2023 Emergency Proclamation Homeless Programs – Federal account ($2,000,000)
